description: Reversible corrections applied to the source before conversion, in this order. Each record keeps the original reading, the correction, whether the print or the source was wrong (error_in), a one-line summary of what was wrong, where it is (the entry and element, or the page, column and line, and the scan page in scan) and the inverse, which is the same change with original and correction exchanged. The evidence behind each record is not part of this file.
